scenes.caption: MultiVitamin Thermafoliant
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica MultiVitamin Thermafoliant, a powerful skin polisher that combines physical and chemical exfoliants.

scenes.caption: Warming microgranules

scenes.say: It polishes away dull skin to reveal fresher skin, and helps improve and smooth skin texture.

items.title: Dermalogica Liquid Peelfoliant Review: 30% Acids + Enzymes, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Liquid Peelfoliant: a professional-grade at-home peel with a blend of 30% acids and enzymes, recommended for dullness, fine lines and wrinkles, and pores.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Liquid Peelfoliant: what's in it, what it does and how to use it.
facts: Professional-grade at-home peel, blend of 30% acids and enzymes
Glycolic, lactic, salicylic, phytic, tranexamic acids, gluconolactone, fermented pomegranate enzyme
Exfoliates, helps unclog pores, smoother brighter skin
Cranberry extract lipid-rich blend for hydration
Dry cleansed skin, 1-3 minutes, rinse; every other day building to daily; moisturizer and SPF by day; keep out of eyes

scenes.caption: Liquid Peelfoliant
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Liquid Peelfoliant, a professional-grade at-home peel. In this review, we cover what is in it, what it does, and exactly how to use it.

scenes.caption: Who it's for
scenes.say: It is recommended for three concerns: dullness, fine lines and wrinkles, and pores.

scenes.caption: 30% acids + enzymes
scenes.say: The formula is a blend of thirty percent acids and enzymes, made to work at different layers of the skin's surface. The product page describes it as a daily peel with fifteen percent AHA, BHA and PHA, ten percent fruit enzymes, five percent phytic acid, and tranexamic acid.

scenes.caption: Glycolic + lactic acid
scenes.say: That blend includes glycolic acid and lactic acid, two alpha hydroxy acids.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid
scenes.say: It also includes salicylic acid, a beta hydroxy acid, along with phytic acid and tranexamic acid.

scenes.caption: Gluconolactone + enzyme
scenes.say: Gluconolactone and a fermented pomegranate enzyme complete the exfoliating blend.

scenes.caption: What it does
scenes.say: Together, they thoroughly exfoliate, help unclog pores, and reveal smoother, brighter skin. It works at different layers of the skin's surface, so the exfoliation is thorough while the peel stays easy to use at home.

scenes.caption: The benefits
scenes.say: The product page lists three benefits: it reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, evens skin tone for brighter skin, and minimizes the appearance of pores.

scenes.caption: Cranberry extract
scenes.say: A lipid-rich blend with upcycled cranberry extract promotes long-lasting hydration.

scenes.caption: Step 1: dry, clean skin
scenes.say: Here is how to use it. Start with dry, cleansed skin, and massage the peel evenly over your face.

scenes.caption: Step 2: 1 to 3 minutes
scenes.say: Leave it on for one to three minutes, then rinse. You may feel some tingling as the product activates.

scenes.caption: Build up slowly
scenes.say: Begin by using it every other day. Notice how your skin responds, and build up to daily use. Starting slowly gives your skin time to adjust to the acids.

scenes.caption: Daytime: moisturizer + SPF
scenes.say: If you use it during the day, follow with a moisturizer and SPF. And keep it out of your eyes.

scenes.caption: Recap
scenes.say: So, the Liquid Peelfoliant is an at-home peel with thirty percent acids and enzymes for dullness, fine lines and pores. Use it on dry, clean skin for one to three minutes, then rinse. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica UltraCalming Cleanser Review: pH-Balanced Gel-Cream, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica UltraCalming Cleanser: a pH-balanced, non-foaming gel-cream cleanser that helps calm and cool reactive, sensitized or overprocessed skin.
items.hook: The Dermalogica UltraCalming Cleanser: what's in it, what it does and how to use it.
facts: pH-balanced, non-foaming gel/cream cleanser for reactive skin
Fortifies protective barrier, no irritating residue
Rinses away or tissues off
Normal, dry, sensitive skin; suitable for oily/acne-prone, especially inflamed breakouts
Removes light makeup; use precleanse for heavier makeup
Follow precleanse, massage upward strokes, rinse; follow with UltraCalming Mist

scenes.caption: UltraCalming Cleanser
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica UltraCalming Cleanser. In this review, we cover what it is, who it suits, and exactly how to use it.

scenes.caption: Gel-cream cleanser
scenes.say: It is a gentle cleansing gel-cream for reactive skin. The formula is pH-balanced and non-foaming.

scenes.caption: Calms and cools
scenes.say: It helps calm and cool reactive, sensitized or overprocessed skin, and helps calm redness and discomfort. It is formulated to be non-stripping, so skin is left feeling soft rather than tight.

scenes.caption: Barrier support
scenes.say: It delicately fortifies the skin's protective barrier without leaving an irritating residue.

scenes.caption: Rinse or tissue off
scenes.say: It rinses away easily or tissues off, and it can be wiped away with a damp, soft wipe when needed. That means you can use it without water when you need to.

scenes.caption: Texture
scenes.say: The texture is a light, creamy gel-cream that is easy to rinse or wipe off.

scenes.caption: Who it's for
scenes.say: It is recommended for normal, dry and sensitive skin.

scenes.caption: Breakout-prone skin
scenes.say: It is also suitable for oily or acne-prone skin, especially if you have inflamed breakouts. It washes away dirt with no residue.

scenes.caption: Botanical extracts
scenes.say: Ingredients include radish root ferment, oat, cucumber, raspberry and lavender extracts, plus panthenol. Dermalogica formulas never use artificial fragrances, so any light scent comes from the botanical extracts and essential oils.

scenes.caption: Makeup
scenes.say: It removes light makeup and impurities. For heavier makeup, use precleanse first as part of a double cleanse.

scenes.caption: Step 1: apply
scenes.say: Here is how to use it. After precleanse, apply it to your face and throat, massaging gently with your fingertips in light, upward strokes.

scenes.caption: Step 2: remove
scenes.say: Then rinse thoroughly with warm water, or remove with dry cotton pads.

scenes.caption: Step 3: follow up
scenes.say: Follow with UltraCalming Mist and your moisturizer. Following with the mist and a moisturizer completes a calming routine for reactive skin.

scenes.caption: Recap
scenes.say: So, the UltraCalming Cleanser is a pH-balanced, non-foaming gel-cream that calms and cools reactive skin, and suits inflamed breakouts too. Massage it in, then rinse or tissue off. The link is in the description.

items.hook: The Dermalogica Daily Milkfoliant: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Vegan milky powder exfoliant with oat and coconut
Activates with water
Grape extract and arginine rich in AHAs and BHAs with coconut milk
Smoother, softer skin
Half-teaspoon in wet hands, massage about 1 minute, rinse, avoid eyes

scenes.caption: Daily Milkfoliant
scenes.say: Meet the Dermalogica Daily Milkfoliant, a vegan, milky powder exfoliant with oat and coconut.

scenes.caption: Activates with water
scenes.say: It activates on contact with water, releasing botanical extracts that help polish away dead skin cells.

scenes.caption: Grape extract + arginine
scenes.say: Fruit-based grape extract and arginine, rich in alpha and beta hydroxy acids, work together with coconut milk for smoother, softer skin.

scenes.caption: Half a teaspoon
scenes.say: To use it, dispense about half a teaspoon into wet hands, and rub them together to create a creamy lather.

scenes.caption: Massage, then rinse
scenes.say: Massage it onto a clean face in circular motions for about one minute, avoiding the eyes, then rinse thoroughly. The link is in the description.
